fields.description: The Acres Estate is the larger five- to seven-bedroom villa offering within The Acres in Dubailand. Its Ivory and Amber collections have distinct plans, with courtyards, generous family spaces and layouts that connect to the surrounding gardens and lagoon community.

overview: Ivory and Amber are different collections, with separate five-, six- and seven-bedroom plans. Seven-bedroom examples add an upper level. The plan disclaimer excludes swimming pools and landscape works and makes them the end user’s responsibility; these costs should not be assumed included.
research.locationNote: Within The Acres in Dubailand. Confirm the chosen collection, phase entrance and actual plot boundaries. The community’s proposed facilities and surrounding roads may be delivered in stages.
research.priceNote: The current linked sheet gives starting guides of AED 14.5 m for five bedrooms, AED 16 m for six and AED 22.2 m for seven. It does not confirm current inventory, every plot’s price or earlier-release terms.
research.paymentNote: Current sheet: 10% booking; 10% August 2025; 10% February 2026; 10% July 2026; 10% December 2026; 5% May 2027; 5% October 2027; 5% February 2028; 35% August 2028 handover. Past launch dates require the chosen unit’s actual balance statement.
research.handoverNote: The current linked release sheet estimates August 2028. Obtain the selected plot’s contractual date; earlier or later phases can differ.

Pools and landscape features in plans are not included and are the end user’s responsibility according to the document. Installation approvals and costs require confirmation.
